desc: Read N and array A from stdin.
Build position lists (1-indexed) for each value from 1 to N.
Compute miss[v] for each value v (subarrays missing v) using gaps between consecutive positions; total = N*(N+1)//2; accumulate sum_distinct = sum_v (total - miss[v]).
For each v from 1 to N-1, merge the position lists of v and v+1 to compute miss_both (subarrays containing neither v nor v+1), then add (total - miss[v] - miss[v+1] + miss_both) to sum_adjacent.
